thread:
raj: Anyone up for a low-key Saturday — vinyl shop crawl, Mel's diner late night, then rooftop stargazing? thinking 8:30 vinyl -> 9:30 diner -> rooftop around 10:45. dog-friendly? :night_with_stars: :guitar:
emily: ooh love vinyl. is Mel's open that late? which rooftop is this?
mike: count me in for the diner. need to drop off a foster dog earlier tho. can we do 8pm instead?
ainsley: I can bring a small telescope! also a bluetooth speaker if needed. :telescope: :speaker:
devon: I have a 7pm show nearby, prob can't make the crawl. maybe meet at the rooftop ~11? there's a free lot by the pier if anyone's driving.
raj: Mel's said they're open till 11 on weekends (saw on their IG) — https://melsdiner.example/menu. rooftop is the new coworking rooftop behind 4th st (public access after 10).
emily: perfect. can someone pick up a folding chair? I'll bring a thermos and instant coffee.
mike: I can bring a couple chairs. also can drive 3 people if needed — how many are we looking at?
ainsley: @mike you're a lifesaver! probs 4-6 folks. @devon if your show ends early you should swing by.
devon: will DM if I can duck out early.
sam-bot: Reminder: public rooftop access closes at midnight, watch for intermittent maintenance. (source: city parks feed)
raj: :thumbsup: ok tentatively 8:30 meet at Mel's, head to rooftop ~10:45. anyone want to bring snacks? @ainsley can you confirm scope?
ainsley: confirmed. bringing a small scope + star chart app. :star2:
emily: I'll bring snacks (maybe dumplings?). vegan options ok?
mike: veg + meat works. ping me if you need a ride.
raj: awesome. last q — anyone up for a moonlit tidepool walk after rooftop? totally optional, only if tide's out. I can check tide times tomorrow.
devon: that sounds magical, maybe next time for me but def check tide times.
emily: moonlit tidepooling yes please but might be chilly. I have a spare jacket.
raj: cool i'll post final plan tomorrow morning. :calendar:
